triangle, circle, trapezium, irregular plots)

content: Volume calculation of various construction shapes (cube, cuboid,
cylinder, cone, sphere)

content: Estimation using Long Wall & Short Wall method for building
works

content: Estimation using Centre Line method for building works

RCC drawings

line method method estimation

content: Rate analysis of brick work structures including material and labour
cost

content: Valuation of construction equipment based on cost and life

content: Study and calculation of different methods of depreciation (SLM,
DBM, sinking fund)

content: Valuation of land and buildings with example on years purchase

content: Field visit to residential building site to study measurement of

estimation methods
